events.continuity_hook: Carry forward two travelers, a Thursday-through-Monday stay, the Friday and Saturday family events, and the goal of keeping Sunday open near the coast.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the complete round-trip costs and usable time for each flight pair, include realistic travel time between San Diego airport and Carlsbad, and select dates and times that fit the four hotel nights.
events.scenario_brief: For the four-night Carlsbad wedding trip, Elena and her spouse have narrowed the Denver-San Diego flights to two Thursday nonstops and two Monday returns. The earlier outbound preserves most of Thursday in Carlsbad but costs more for two travelers, while the later one reaches the hotel after dinner; on Monday, the less expensive return requires checking out and driving south during the morning commute. The Friday rehearsal dinner, Saturday wedding, and Sunday coastal day remain fixed.

events.continuity_hook: Use the selected San Diego flights and four-night Thursday-to-Monday stay while keeping the rehearsal dinner, wedding, and free Sunday in view.
events.interaction_goal: Calculate comparable four-night totals, map travel times to both wedding venues, and choose the shared room that best balances family logistics with a practical coastal Sunday.
events.scenario_brief: With Thursday and Monday flights selected, Elena and her spouse need one room for four nights. A Carlsbad Village hotel is walkable to the beach and restaurants but charges separately for parking, a property closer to the wedding site has a lower total but would require driving on Sunday, and an Oceanside hotel offers an oceanfront room while adding time to both family venues. Taxes, parking, and cancellation dates make the advertised nightly rates misleading.

events.continuity_hook: Refer to the confirmed four-night hotel, Monday airport drive, and existing rental-car return while reassessing the altered flight.
events.interaction_goal: Recalculate the checkout-to-gate timeline, compare the shifted and later departures, and identify any airline, hotel, or rental updates required after the decision.
events.scenario_brief: The flights, Carlsbad Village hotel, and rental car are now confirmed, but the airline has moved Monday's San Diego departure seventy minutes earlier. The hotel checkout time is unchanged, the rental must be refueled and returned at the airport, and the new departure falls close to the busiest part of the southbound drive. A later nonstop can be selected through the airline at no added fare, although it would extend the final day.

events.continuity_hook: Open a new professional trip from Denver around the Tuesday dinner, full Wednesday schedule, and Thursday afternoon finish.
events.interaction_goal: Develop several complete flight-and-hotel combinations, including the extra cost of a Monday arrival, downtown-to-airport travel time, and workable margins before the first and after the final event.
events.scenario_brief: Elena has a January university-press sales and rights summit in downtown Phoenix. A small-group dinner begins Tuesday at 6:30 p.m., meetings occupy Wednesday, and the final planning session ends Thursday at 2:00 p.m. She needs to determine whether to arrive Tuesday or Monday, find lodging for two or three nights near the meeting site, and compare Thursday flights that leave enough time to reach the airport after the closing session.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the Tuesday dinner, Thursday 2:00 p.m. finish, and downtown lodging area fixed while narrowing the outbound and return pair.
events.interaction_goal: Select a round trip with credible ground-transfer margins, compare the fare and schedule tradeoffs, and establish the exact two-night hotel dates.
events.scenario_brief: The Phoenix trip has narrowed to two Tuesday Denver departures. One arrives before hotel check-in but leaves ample time before dinner, while the other costs less and reaches Phoenix with a limited delay margin. For Thursday, a late-afternoon nonstop is feasible only with a prompt departure from the closing session, while an evening flight allows an unhurried airport transfer but returns to Denver much later.

events.continuity_hook: Carry forward the selected flights, two-night stay, downtown summit site, Tuesday dinner, and Thursday evening departure.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the full lodging totals and walking times, verify Thursday luggage arrangements and checkout timing, and prepare the most practical reservation for office booking.
events.scenario_brief: After choosing the Tuesday outbound and evening Thursday return, Elena is comparing two downtown Phoenix hotels for Tuesday and Wednesday nights. The summit hotel has direct access to every meeting but a higher total and an earlier cancellation deadline; a nearby hotel is less expensive and within walking distance, though luggage would need to be stored after Thursday checkout. A third property appears cheaper until taxes and its daily destination fee are included.
